description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes related to Git's attribute checking mechanism, including querying and managing attributes for paths in a repository.

classes.name: git_attr
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a Git attribute, identified by its name.

classes.name: attr_check_item
classes.description: Represents one attribute and its value for a specific path.

classes.name: attr_check
classes.description: Collection of attribute check items used to query attributes for paths.

classes.name: attr_state
classes.description: Represents the state of an attribute (set, unset, string value).

classes.name: pattern
classes.description: Represents a filename pattern used in attribute rules.

classes.name: match_attr
classes.description: Represents a rule from a .gitattributes file, either macro or pattern-based.

methods.name: attr_check_initl
methods.description: Initializes an attr_check with attribute names.

methods.name: attr_check_append
methods.description: Appends a git_attr to an attr_check.

methods.name: git_attr_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a git_attr.

methods.name: git_check_attr
methods.description: Checks attributes for a given path.

methods.name: git_all_attrs
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes applicable to a path.

methods.name: git_attr_set_direction
methods.description: Sets the direction for attribute checking (check-in, checkout, index).

methods.name: parse_attr_line
methods.description: Parses a line from a gitattributes file into a match_attr rule.
